mapper.select: SELECT BRAND_ID as brandId, BRAND_NAME as brandName FROM BRAND ORDER BY BRAND_NAME ASC

SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID as productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME as productName, p.PRODUCT_TYPE as productType, p.PRICE as price, p.DEPOSIT as deposit, p.DESCRIPTION as description, p.IS_AVAILABLE as isAvailable, p.CREATED_AT as createdAt, p.CATEGORY_ID as categoryId, p.BRAND_ID as brandId, b.BRAND_NAME as brandName, i.IMG_URL as imgUrl FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE p.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT IMG_URL as imgUrl, IS_MAIN as mainImg, SORT_ORDER as sortOrder FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, SORT_ORDER ASC
